name: Alfvén
description: Driven 2D incompressible MHD in vorticity / flux-function form. The solver is a COMPUTE pipeline (AlfvenSolver, ALFVEN.4) — spectral Poisson, spectral Poisson brackets, Hou-Li filter, 2/3 dealiasing and the spike's integrating factor, stepped by a Swift substep loop with a CFL-adaptive timestep. Moved off the staged fragment path because substeps saw stale derivatives and adaptive dt was inexpressible there. PLACEHOLDER exposure until a reduction surface exists for film.py's percentile auto-exposure; no audio routing until ALFVEN.3.
